# 1 Enoch Chapter 52 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**52:1** And-after-those-days in-that-place-where I-had-seen all-the-visions of-that-which-is-hidden — for-I-had-been-carried-off in-a-whirlwind and-they-had-borne-me-towards-the-west — there-mine-eyes-saw all-the-secret-things of-heaven that-shall-be, a-mountain of-iron, and-a-mountain of-copper, and-a-mountain of-silver, and-a-mountain of-gold, and-a-mountain of-soft-metal, and-a-mountain of-lead.

**52:2** And-I-asked the-angel who-went-with-me, saying: "What-are-these-things which-I-have-seen in-secret?"

**52:3** And-he-said-unto-me: "All-these-things which-thou-hast-seen shall-serve the-dominion of-His-Anointed that-he-may-be-potent and-mighty-on-the-earth."

**52:4** And-that-angel of-peace answered-me, saying: "Wait-a-little, and-there-shall-be-revealed-unto-thee all-the-secret-things which-surround-the-Lord of-Spirits.

**52:5** And-these-mountains of-iron, and-these-mountains of-copper, and-these-mountains of-silver, and-these-mountains of-gold, and-these-mountains of-soft-metal, and-these-mountains of-lead: all-these-before the-Elect-One-will-be-as-wax-before the-fire, and-as-the-water-which-streams-down from-above upon-these-mountains, and-they-shall-become-powerless before-his-feet."

**52:6** "And-it-shall-come-to-pass in-those-days that-none-shall-be-saved, either-by-gold or-by-silver, and-none-be-able-to-escape."

**52:7** "And-there-shall-be-no-iron for-war, nor-shall-one-clothe-oneself-with-a-breastplate; bronze-shall-be-of-no-avail, and-tin-shall-be-of-no-avail and-shall-not-be-esteemed, and-lead-shall-not-be-desired."

**52:8** "And-all-these-things shall-be-denied and-destroyed from-the-surface of-the-earth, when-the-Elect-One shall-appear before the-face of-the-Lord of-Spirits."

---

*EMET notes: The vision of the six mountains of metals (v. 1) is interpreted as the instruments of earthly power that will dissolve before the Elect One (v. 5 — "like wax before fire"). The six metals echo Dan 2 (the statue of metals). V. 3 refers to "His Anointed" — the Elect One is God's Anointed One (Messiah). The chapter closely parallels 38:5–6, suggesting the Parables used a common source.*
